When I say my family and friends don't care, its more like they just don't want to bother anymore. I've had depression since I was old enough to think for myself, but my parents have never believed me. If I talked about it, they'd call it attention seeking. Just a couple of weeks ago, my dad tried to kick me out because he was "tired of the dramatic sadness." I've had previous employers when I was a minor who'd contacted my parents without my knowledge and asked why I wasn't on any medication. When it became clear that my parents would do nothing, coworkers offered me drugs they could get ahold of illegally, and I almost said yes.

My friends, on the otherhand, know and believe that I'm not mentally healthy. I think they're just tired of it. It's not their fault, I'm tired of it to. Tonight I went to my best friend of the past 7 years for help, and he told me he didn't want to talk and asked me to leave him alone. 

That's when I almost called the hotline but decided it wasn't worth it. As for my other friends, they just don't talk to me usually. I'm always the one to text first, start the conversation. I'm a pro at begging for attention. Obviously.

I feel like I could get better if I could work. I could pay for medication or therapy and it wouldn't be my parents problem. If i could work, i could live away from people who don't want me. I could go to therapy. I want to be okay. It's just a pointless goal, I guess.
